en.hubeali:
And by this chain, 
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘
They would never be poor, the family which is habitual with the vinegar, and the oil, and that is the sauce of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 7. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated: “’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘
A family that uses vinegar and oil as their sauce, never becomes needy; it is the sauce of the Prophets, ‘Alayhim al-Salam.’”
